editorial:
You are a loving dad who just wants to make your kid's birthday special. When the clown you hired cancels at the last minute, you find an old clown suit in a dusty trunk and throw it on. The party is a hit, but the next morning you cannot get the suit off. The wig is glued to your head, the nose is stuck to your face, and the colorful outfit seems to be growing into your skin. What starts as a funny mishap quickly turns into a nightmare as you feel yourself changing into something hungry and cruel.

The movie does a great job building dread from such a silly starting point. The lead actor sells the slow transformation with real fear and sadness, and the practical effects are gross in the best way. The pacing keeps you on edge, though some middle scenes drag a bit. If you love body horror and creepy clown stories, this one is a solid pick. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture quality.
endingExplained: Kent fully transforms into the monster and attacks children at a play center. Meg realizes the only way to stop him is to kill him, so she does, saving their son Jack. The final twist comes when Jack finds the red clown nose and puts it on, hinting the curse is not over and could pass to the next wearer. It leaves you with a chill that the nightmare might just be starting again.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves body horror and creepy clown stories.
